The story follows Toomi Yuna, High school girl who comes into contact with a pair of ghosts, Sachi and Megumi (kindred spirits). The kindred spirits ask Yuna to help them reach the after-life, as the ghosts can't experience love in ways they would if alive. So Yuna becomes the Cupid of this story, pairing, repairing and helping nurture relationships of girls in an all girls school. Did I mention that this is yuri?

If you are planning to check it out, I'd recommend buying it from steam, just so that if you don't like it, you can return it for under 2 hours play-time. The whole thing is 30 hours (I don't know about 30-40 hours, I read the extras too, and would not call myself a speed reader). Yuri Cupid 1 and Yuri Cupid 2 won't take long at all to read, and you'll be able to know what to expect out of it. Though this is NSFW and has some love scenes, it's more on the soft side, the sell is the romantic stories of the characters, not the sex. The sex scenes are rather tame.

I thought going into this there would be some supernatural part to it. That the kindred spirits might do some 'ghost stuff' to help each of the couples but it's not the case. Instead the 'ghost stuff' is more like a fly on the wall, that the kindred spirits (and the VN reader) can see what is going on for each couple. Which is good, because it makes each of the couples relationship more believable. No supernatural stuff to force help the girls together, just them doing normal things while finding their feelings for one another.

The couples relationships are varied enough, you'll find interest in some more than others and the games "calendar planer" you can know that Yuna will be helping one couple more than others for that period of time. Speaking of Yuna, she comes the center of everyone, and if there were a "best girl" competition, she would win, only because she gets so much scene time. At first she's a bit of a loner, she has Hina and Ano to talk to, but there is a reason she always eats her lunch by herself on the roof, and that eating with the kindred spirits only comes later. Yuna does not really understand love, much less yuri, but does see other couples in some need of help and has satisfaction in helping them out. Her whole character change through the months spent with the kindred spirits and with her new friends, as she becomes partially in contact with the couples she helps, is excellent. You learn the reason why she wants her meddling with other couples to be from the shadows as Yuna begins to better understand herself.

As for the other couples, you might only get a quick line as to why they are the way they are, and that is fine. I'm fine when a story explains comes up with a simple explanation as to why the characters are the way they are, and lets them do their act to continue the story. I like the quick back-story of the long one any day. Example: If a character likes to run, the reason is she has the running spirit, and we see her run many times. Each of the couple has to overcome some hardship, and some are harder than others, but each one is about the feelings they have for each other, and what they mean. Just the sort of thing you want in a romance VN.

My one complaint is the music. It's not bad, but this game is 30 hours long and it's repetition might annoy some, it became an issue for me, so I muted after some point.

If you are interested in Yuri romance, pick this one up, you won't regret it. If you don't like yuri, the all-girls school thing will turn you away, even when the romance story is enjoyable.
